data.title: 八重神子 · 海滨祭典的油豆腐冰饮
data.description: 【稻妻海滨祭典·盛夏】八重神子穿着粉白泳装外搭轻薄祭典罩衫，坐在海边高台上摇着折扇，手边放着油豆腐风味冰饮；她看着远处烟火，狐耳随海风微动，转回镜头时笑得像早已猜到所有人的心思。
data.action: 海滨高台摇扇看烟火，狐耳随海风微动，回眸像早已看穿心思
data.lighting: deep summer dusk, lanterns and fireworks
data.mood: 宫司把度假也写成一场戏
data.promptProse: Seated above the Inazuma shore, Yae Miko turns back knowingly with a folding fan in one hand and a chilled tofu-flavored drink in the other. Sea wind lifts pink hair beside her fox ears, gold ornaments and light festival robe over a pink-and-white swimsuit. The horizontal medium view places the dark sea below the terrace. Summer dusk and lanterns outline the robe; fireworks glint in the drink and her eyes.
